content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICAR IARI Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICAR IARI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Master’s degree in Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with 4/5 years bachelor’s degree. Those with 3 years bachelor’s degree must have UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET qualification or equivalent or a Ph.D. in any of the above disciplines. Desirable: Experience in Molecular Breeding, biotechnology, and proficiency in computer application. Young Professional-I (YP-I): Graduation degree in Agricultural Science or Diploma in Agricultural Sciences / Life Sciences and Equivalent from a recognized university. Desirable: Working knowledge of computer and MS Office or Hands on experience of working on Molecular markers/Emasculation and pollination work.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age Relaxation: For SRF: 5 years for SC/ST & women, 3 years for OBC. For YP-I: 5 years for SC/ST/Women, 3 years for OBC. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): ₹37,000 + HRA/month for 1st and 2nd year; ₹42,000 + HRA/month for 3rd year Young Professional-I (YP-I): ₹30,000/month (fixed); no HRA

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional-I posts at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute is scheduled for 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional-I positions at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: For the SRF post, candidates need a Master’s degree in Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with a 4/5 years bachelor’s degree, or a Ph.D. with a 3-year bachelor's degree and NET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) position?
faq.answer: The Young Professional-I position offers a fixed salary of ₹30,000 per month, with no House Rent Allowance (HRA) provided.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age relaxation for SC/ST candidates applying for the SRF post?
faq.answer: SC/ST candidates applying for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual posts at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a walk-in interview, followed by document verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi, 110012.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply online for these positions?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview process, and online applications are not accepted.
